text: dsh-tui-pi 是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的类 pi 终端编码代理界面，在 DSH 进程内运行并接入代理、命令和会话服务。它提供模型与预设切换、可浏览和分叉的历史记录、跨会话全文搜索、子代理状态与现场查看、提问确认面板、可编辑设置和多主题。适合希望在终端中持续使用 DSH 编码代理、管理会话和子代理的开发者。需安装 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本，以及 Node.js 22.19.0 以上；可用 npm 全局安装并由启动器创建 TUI 配置。

dsh-tui-pi is a pi-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness. It offers model and preset switching, session history and search, subagent views, questions, settings, and themes. Manage coding-agent sessions from a terminal. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+ and Node.js 22.19.0+; install globally with npm.

dsh-tui-pi 的功能「会话历史」：用 /history 浏览已完成轮次及回复，可从旧轮次分叉新会话；回看时也能复制提示词到编辑器。
dsh-tui-pi 的功能「跨会话搜索」：通过 /search 搜索已存会话的全文，结果显示匹配片段并可打开目标会话。
dsh-tui-pi 的功能「模型选择」：使用 /model 打开模型选择器，切换提供方、模型和推理强度，并保存默认模型。
dsh-tui-pi 的功能「交互提问」：模型可通过 ask_user_question 暂停请求，用户在停靠面板逐项选择或填写答案。
dsh-tui-pi 的功能「主题管理」：从内置目录和用户的 DSH_HOME/themes 加载主题 JSON，可在 TUI 内切换界面配色。
dsh-tui-pi 的功能「子代理查看」：快捷键 Ctrl+G 打开子代理选择器，查看运行状态及其转录，并可在界面中操作。
dsh-tui-pi 的功能「设置浏览器」：/settings 浏览 DSH 插件配置并通过表单修改值，支持分类和字段编辑。
dsh-tui-pi 要求 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本，并声明 Node.js >=22.19.0；启动时会检查宿主版本。

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · dsh-tui-pi：A fully-featured pi-style terminal UI for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) — a plugin suite that turns dsh into a pi-like coding-agent experience: /history look-back & fork-at-turn, guided preset switching, live subagent steering, model profiles, 20+ built-in themes (10 light + 10 dark) with user theme directory discovery, and a powerline footer.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · dsh-tui-pi：**Requires dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1** — this plugin targets the dsh RC/stable line only (CI and releases resolve the newest of the `latest`/`next` dist-tags at runtime). **The alpha line is no longer supported.** A startup guard logs a one-line warning and exits cleanly when the host is older than the floor (opt out with `DSH_TUI_SKIP_HOST_CHECK=1`). See [ADR 0002](docs/adr/0002-target-dsh-0.1.2-alpha.3-single-target.md) for the now-superseded alpha single-target decision.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Install and launch：```sh
npm i -g @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi

```

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Install and launch：The global install sets the machine up by itself, printing one progress line per step: it installs the `@deepseek-ai/dsh` host when missing (via npm, resolved as the newest of the `latest`/`next` dist-tags — the `latest` tag alone lags the rc line; if npm itself is not on PATH, it prints what to install and stops), installs pnpm, and creates the `tui` profile with this plugin and its bundled companions. Host compatibility window: **0.2.2-rc.1 and newer** — a host at or above the floor is kept as-is; an older one is upgraded automatically. Whatever the install cannot finish (e.g. an offline machine) completes automatically on the first launch. After a later `npm i -g` upgrade of this package, the profile's mounted copy is moved to the new version on the next launch — a profile that is newer than the global install (dev-upgraded ahead) is left untouched.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Install and launch：The manual steps do exactly what the onboarding runs, if you prefer them:

```sh
npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
npm i -g pnpm
dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi
dsh --profile tui          # launch

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Install and launch：Never add `@deepseek-ai/*` packages to a profile by hand — the host provides them, and their npm `latest` tag is a 0.0.1 stub (a bare-name `pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` lands that stub next to the plugin and shadows the host's copy; the symptom is the loader's `does not provide an export named …` and the plugin not activating). The `dsh-tui-pi` launcher checks for exactly this before every boot and, when it finds a shadowing copy, stops with both paths, both versions and the removal commands instead of booting into the broken state.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Install and launch：Legacy `session_projcache` records (written before dsh 0.1.2-alpha.4) are migrated automatically at profile load — idempotent, with per-file backups, never blocking startup; the `dsh-tui-pi` launcher runs the same preflight.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Install and launch：Everything that used to need manual patching — the canvas background, the `@deepseek-ai` module closure, the compaction backend — now happens automatically. For a normal install, upgrading the global package upgrades the profile on the next launch (see above). `dev-upgrade` remains for dev machines that install the profile from a checked-out repo:

```sh
node scripts/dev-upgrade.mjs                  # latest
node scripts/dev-upgrade.mjs 1.0.5 --dry-run  # preview the plan first
```

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi
```

The `dsh-tui-pi` bin shim is global and can stay; if you installed the package globally and want it gone too: `npm -g rm @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi`.

The host cleans up the profile automatically: the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry is spliced and the whole patch layer goes away with the package — the stock `session-projection-cache` row re-enables, and the projcache wrapper, the `tool-ask-user` insert and its disable row all vanish.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Uninstall：User data stays on disk on purpose (deleting it is destructive; a reinstall reuses all of it): `~/.dsh/APPEND_SYSTEM.md`, `tui-command-usage.json`, `model-profiles.json`, `keybindings.json`, `~/.dsh/agents/` + `~/.dsh/skills/`, workspace `.dsh-profile` pins, the `dsh-tui` entry config in the profile patch (a pre-0.1.7 `settings.yaml` section lands there as `settings.yaml.imported`), and the session projection cache (incl. `.bak-preflight-*` migration backups). While the plugin runs, the retention janitor (default `maxCount: 300` / `maxAgeDays: 90`) deletes old session logs — uninstalling stops that, but already-deleted logs are gone. `scripts/install-font.mjs` mutates OS font/terminal state and has a documented backup; uninstall doesn't touch it.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Companion plugins：**Default dependencies** — the nine plugins below ship with this package (installed into the profile's `node_modules`); activation still follows the profile's `bundles` list — list each one there to activate it.

- [@aiwayds/dsh-profile-switch](https://github.com/fan56/dsh-profile-switch) — `/profile-switch` + `/profile-cfg`: named model profiles switched and configured through the host's ask-user flow, on the TUI and the web (the panels this suite used to carry). Add it to your pro

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Keyboard shortcuts：| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | Send the prompt |
| `Esc` | **Double-press to stop everything** — the first press arms, the second opens a confirmation dialog naming what is running (main turn + subagent count); `Enter` there stops the main turn AND every running subagent, `Esc` keeps everything running. A popup open closes it instead. Works while only background subagents run. |
| `Ctrl+C` | Mid-task: first press stops (same everything-stop, no dialog), second quits; idle: clears editor / quits. Held-key auto-repeat never quits. |
| `Ctrl+D` | Quit (only when the editor is empty) |
| `Ctrl+L` | Open the model/think picker |
| `Ctrl+G` | Open the subagent picker (viewer `Enter` opens steer, `x ×2` stops that subagent while it runs / closes when settled) |
| `Ctrl+O` | Pending-message queue (s steer now · d remove) |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | Transcript search (pi-tui built-in): `Enter`/`Ctrl+G` next match, `Shift+Enter`/`Ctrl+Shift+G` previous, `Esc` close |
| `Ctrl+Alt+F` | Cross-session full-text search — same as `/search`: `Enter` opens the hit (resume; `↳` child rows open a read-only browse), `n` loads more, `q` starts a new query

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Keyboard shortcuts：Remap any app key through `~/.dsh/keybindings.json` (a partial JSON map, live-applied) or interactively with `/hotkeys`.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Configuration：Everything lives in the plugin's `dsh-tui` entry config inside your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (dsh 0.1.7 projects every volatile field of a plugin's declared Config schema into the settings surface) — but you rarely touch the file: **`/settings` browses and edits it in place** (searchable categories — Agent Presets / General / Models / Plugins / TUI — with live values, per-field descriptions, and an add-provider flow under Models). Language, theme, panel height, footer hints and icon set hot-apply on change; the rest reads at the next launch.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Configuration：Most knobs have sensible defaults and need no configuration. The few you might actually set:

```yaml
- id: dsh-tui         # the plugin's entry row in the profile patch
  config:
    language: zh-CN   # UI language — or just /language (asks on any surface; bundled: en, zh-CN, ja, ko)
    theme: auto       # auto / light / dark / any registered theme name — or /theme

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Configuration：`/agents → l` also mirrors the OFFICIAL dsh-subagent caps (`maxActiveSubagents`, default 8; `maxDepth`, default 1) as read-only rows — those belong to the `subagent` plugin entry and are edited in `/settings`, while the panel's own rows (maxAgents / maxRounds / maxRoundsGrace / the two fences) stay hot-editable here.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Configuration：Upgrading from dsh 0.1.5? Your old `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` `dsh-tui:` section is imported into the profile automatically on the first 0.1.7 boot (the original file is kept next to it as `settings.yaml.imported`).

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Configuration：Adding a UI language is one JSON file in `~/.dsh/locales/` — a same-id file merges per key over the bundled one, a new id registers (details: [Settings browser & UI languages](docs/features/settings-i18n.md)). The session-store janitors (`retention` / `resume`) and ask-user timeouts (`askUser`) live in the same entry config with documented defaults.

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · Configuration：The plugin ships a bundled skill (`dsh-tui-pi-config`): ask the agent to "configure the TUI" and it collects your choices interactively and writes the section for you. **The full key table and the `DSH_TUI_*` env var list live in [skills/dsh-tui-pi-config/SKILL.md](skills/dsh-tui-pi-config/SKILL.md).**

dsh plugin --profile <name> remove @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi

`dsh-tui-pi` 启动器是全局 bin shim，留着无妨；若还全局安装过本包，用 `npm -g rm @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi` 一并移除。

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · 卸载：以下内容刻意留在磁盘上（删用户数据是破坏性的；重装会全部复用）：`~/.dsh/APPEND_SYSTEM.md`、`tui-command-usage.json`、`model-profiles.json`、`keybindings.json`、`~/.dsh/agents/` 与 `~/.dsh/skills/`、工作区 `.dsh-profile` 固定文件、profile patch 里的 `dsh-tui` entry 配置（0.1.7 前的 `settings.yaml` 段会以 `settings.yaml.imported` 保留）、会话投影缓存（含 `.bak-preflight-*` 迁移备份）。插件运行期间，保留清理器（默认 `maxCount: 100` / `maxAgeDays: 30`）会删除旧会话日志——卸载后即停止，但已删除的日志找不回来。`scripts/install-font.mjs` 会改动 OS 字体/终端状态且有文档化的备份；卸载不会碰它。

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · 键盘快捷键：| 按键 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `Enter` | 发送 prompt |
| `Esc` | **双击停止一切 LLM 工作**——第一击进入待发状态，第二击弹出确认框（列明正在运行的主 turn 与子代理数）；`Enter` 确认后停止主 turn **和**所有运行中的子代理，`Esc` 维持运行。仅有后台子代理在跑时同样有效。有 popup 打开时双击改为关闭它 |
| `Ctrl+C` | 任务中：第一次停止（同一"停止一切"，无确认框），第二次退出；空闲时：清空编辑器 / 退出。长按自动重复绝不会触发退出。 |
| `Ctrl+D` | 退出（仅在编辑器为空时） |
| `Ctrl+L` | 打开 model/think 选择器 |
| `Ctrl+G` | 打开 subagent 选择器（查看器内 `Enter` 打开 steer；子代理运行中 `x ×2` 停止它，已结束后 `x ×2` 关闭面板） |
| `Ctrl+O` | 待发消息队列（`s` 立即 steer · `d` 移除） |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 本会话内 transcript 搜索（pi-tui 内置）：`Enter`/`Ctrl+G` 下一个、`Shift+Enter`/`Ctrl+Shift+G` 上一个、`Esc` 关闭 |
| `Ctrl+Alt+F` | 跨会话全文搜索，同 `/search`：`Enter` 打开命中（父会话恢复；`↳` 子代理命中只读浏览）、`n` 加载更多、`q` 新查询、`Esc` 关闭。`/search` 任何终端可用；组合键以传统 `ESC+Ctrl+F` 编码到达大多数终端 |
| `↑` / `↓` | 浏览已提交消息历史 |

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · 键盘快捷键：通过 `~/.dsh/keybindings.json`（部分 JSON 映射，实时应用）或 `/hotkeys` 交互式重映射任意 app 按键。

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · 配置：所有配置都在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件 `dsh-tui` entry 的 `config:` 段（dsh 0.1.7 会把插件声明的 Config schema 中所有 volatile 字段投影进设置面）——但你很少需要直接碰文件：**`/settings` 就地浏览修改**（可搜索的一级分类——Agent Presets / General / Models / Plugins / TUI——实时值、逐字段描述，Models 下还有 add-provider 流程）。语言、主题、面板高度、footer 提示、图标集改动即热生效；其余下次启动读取。

大多数旋钮都有合理默认值，无需配置。真正可能会设的就几项：

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · 配置：```yaml
- id: dsh-tui         # profile patch 里本插件的 entry 行
  config:
    language: zh-CN   # 界面语言——或直接 /language（任意 surface 可答；内置 en、zh-CN、ja、ko）
    theme: auto       # auto / light / dark / 任意已注册主题名——或 /theme

`/agents → l` 还会以只读行镜像**官方** dsh-subagent 上限（`maxActiveSubagents`，默认 8；`maxDepth`，默认 1）——它们属于 `subagent` 插件 entry，在 `/settings` 里改；面板自家的行（maxAgents / maxRounds / maxRoundsGrace / 两个围栏）仍在此处热编辑。

@aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi README · 配置：从 dsh 0.1.5 升级？旧 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 的 `dsh-tui:` 段会在首次 0.1.7 启动时自动导入 profile（原文件保留在同目录的 `settings.yaml.imported`）。

新增界面语言就是往 `~/.dsh/locales/` 放一个 JSON 文件——同名 id 按键合并到内置文件之上，新 id 直接注册（详见[设置浏览器与界面语言](docs/features/settings-i18n.md)）。会话清理器（`retention` / `resume`）与 ask-user 超时（`askUser`）也在同一 entry config 里，默认值见文档。

插件内置了一个 skill（`dsh-tui-pi-config`）：直接让 agent「帮我配置 TUI」，它会问答式收集你的选择并代写配置段。**全键表与 `DSH_TUI_*` 环境变量清单见 [skills/dsh-tui-pi-config/SKILL.md](skills/dsh-tui-pi-config/SKILL.md)。**
